Multiple Arrests Made in Separate Theft and Robbery Cases

Authorities have reported significant busts in two separate criminal incidents. In one case, a mobile phone theft racket was dismantled with 10 arrests and the recovery of 325 stolen phones and ₹1 crore. Separately, in Bengaluru, five individuals were arrested in connection with a kidnapping and robbery case involving ₹1.09 crore, with ₹85.5 lakh recovered.
